_comment: Sample direct input for L0-target-architecture-generator (HarvestLink). The prd and binding_principles fields are pasted in full at run time; they are abbreviated here. architecture_notes is the one input the PRD does not hold and is shown complete. epics_and_features is optional and shown with the shape expected.

external_systems.name: Outbound email delivery
external_systems.role: Delivers invoices and notices and returns evidence of delivery

external_systems.name: Payment service provider
external_systems.role: Collects buyer payments and disburses producer payouts
external_systems.note: Provider not yet selected; selection and integration model are design open items

existing_enterprise_systems_touched.name: SMDS
existing_enterprise_systems_touched.relationship: read-only check at producer onboarding for an existing wholesale supplier record

existing_enterprise_systems_touched.name: Data Warehouse

decisions_already_taken: HarvestLink never takes title to goods; no posting to the group financial ledger
External parties authenticate through the group-approved external identity provider, not employee SSO
known_open_items: Scope of the Finance and Compliance operator experience, including audit access, is not yet defined
Availability target for the buyer checkout path has not been validated with the product owner

epics_and_features._comment: Optional. Only used for the capability map and a feature-to-context coverage check. Omit the field entirely if epics have not been produced.

features.title: Producer registration with FBO registration capture
Compliance document upload and expiry tracking
Browse and search with localised prices
Checkout with VAT and fee shown before confirmation
Order history for buyers and producers
